Bloomberg yesterday reported that Apple is collaborating with LG to develop new smart home accessories, which will be sold under the LG brand. Leaked images revealed designs for a smart door lock, thermostat, and temperature sensor.

The images revealed three Home accessories that Apple allegedly developed for LG

Next week, Apple is rumored to announce a long-awaited major update to its Home product lineup. Apple will launch an all-new Apple TV 4K, a new HomePod mini, and an entirely new product category we have been calling the "HomePad".

However, yesterday's Bloomberg report revealed another piece of Apple's Home strategy. Apple has partnered with LG to develop new Home accessories, which will be sold under the LG brand.

According to the report, these accessories include a smart door lock, thermostat, temperature sensor, video doorbell, indoor camera, outdoor camera, and a floodlight camera.

Today, leaker pdfu shared the first images of three of these products: the smart door lock, smart thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Popular posts on LateStage

Isn't LG the same TV brand that was caught monitoring users even when the TV was turned off? Where has Apple's commitment to privacy gone?

pdfu also posted on X to share more details about these products.

For example, the smart door lock features a rotating dial, with functions including "an LED ring around the touchpad, an alert sound when the door is not closed properly, and lock volume adjustment," along with other features like auto-unlock.

Mark Gurman noted that these new products may not launch alongside the new Apple HomePod and Apple TV. However, Apple may still mention these products at next week's event.

What are your thoughts on these smart home accessories designed by Apple and sold under the LG brand? Feel free to share your opinion in the comments below.

Featured Apple Home accessory recommendations

  • eufy 4K camera (supports HomeKit Secure Video)
  • Aqara smart door lock (supports Apple Home Key and UWB)
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug (four-pack)
  • Aqara smart thermostat (supports adaptive temperature)
